description: Question-answer acceptance scenarios. Expected evidence snippets must exist in the source text and should be manually verified.

cases.question: What should be recorded before escalating an incident?
expected_evidence: Record the time, error message, and relevant request or incident identifier.
Capture sanitized logs only; never collect passwords, access tokens, or private keys.

cases.question: What is the default access duration and what exception is allowed?
expected_evidence: Temporary VPN access expires after 14 calendar days unless renewed.
Employees assigned to a documented high-priority incident may receive one seven-day extension.

cases.question: What is the secret name of the lunar database?
What is the maintenance time?
expected_evidence: The database service is restarted every Sunday at 02:00.
